executive_summary: The proposed project involves collecting operational data from {equipment} using {protocols} and integrating the collected information into {data_destination}. The proposed solution is intended to establish a centralized approach for collecting and maintaining equipment data to support operational monitoring and future analysis.
project_scope: The preliminary project scope includes reviewing the existing infrastructure supporting {equipment}, confirming connectivity requirements for {protocols}, and identifying the components necessary to collect and integrate operational data into {data_destination}. Final implementation requirements will be confirmed during project discovery.
discovery_requirements: Additional discovery is required to confirm the number of data points, collection frequency, network connectivity, infrastructure availability, and system integration requirements. These details will help establish the final project scope, technical approach, and implementation responsibilities.
